annual_probability.cite: Of ~20 quarterly earnings-week moves in research/CHTR/2026-10-08-mc-inputs.json event_weeks (2021 Q3 - 2026 Q2), 1 reached this magnitude (-23.87%, Q1 2026, week 2026-04-20): per-quarter probability ~1/20=0.05; over 4 releases/year, P(at least one) = 1-(0.95)^4, approx 0.19.

jumps.reason: CFO Jessica Fischer steps down October 15, 2026, mid-integration of the Cox acquisition, with Kevin Howard named interim CFO, raising execution risk at a sensitive point in realizing the guided >$1bn of synergies.
jumps.cite: research/CHTR/2026-10-08.md section 6 'Unusual items'; https://www.reuters.com/business/charter-communications-cfo-fischer-step-down-october-2026-08-31/; https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/charter-announces-chief-financial-officer-transition-302865300.html; evaluation bear case.

annual_probability.cite: CFO departure itself is certain (already announced, effective 2026-10-15, Reuters 2026-08-31), but a materially disruptive market reaction during the Cox integration is less than certain; 0.3 reflects that uncertainty, with no historical analogue available to calibrate it more precisely (see assumption).

impact.cite: No matching week in research/CHTR/2026-10-08-mc-inputs.json largest_falls/event_weeks for a CFO/leadership-transition shock specifically; impact is an assumed value capped well below the montecarlo config's max_jump_impact_assumed of 0.30 for an unanalogued jump.

jumps.assumption: No historical analogue exists in the jump table for a CFO/leadership transition; the announcement week itself (2026-08-31) moved only -1.06% (research/CHTR/2026-10-08-mc-inputs.json analogues.all_weekly_moves), too small to use as a tail-risk analogue, so a modest, capped impact is assumed instead.

technical_tilt.cite: Fact sheet Price section (research/CHTR/factsheet-2026-10-08.md): price is -23.0% vs its 50-day MA and -38.3% vs its 200-day MA, with -22.5% 3-month and -52.2% 6-month momentum, and a new 6-month/52-week low of 104.91 made 2026-10-05, two trading days before the decision date — a consistent, persistent downtrend across all horizons, so the maximum allowed bearish 3-month tilt is applied.
